name: predge-whale-data
description: Signed delivery verdicts for AI-agent payments, plus outcome-verified Polymarket whale data and settlement risk, pay-per-call over x402.
long_description: 25 tools (7 free + 18 paid). Delivery verdicts: predge_verdict answers 'was the paid job delivered?' with an ed25519-signed verdict (delivered | not_delivered | inconclusive), per-check results and a refund recommendation; predge_get_verdict re-reads one for free and predge_verdict_report returns the signed monthly report for your key. Free: endpoint discovery, predge_settlement_risk (signed live UMA dispute/settlement risk for any Polymarket market, from Polygon), predge_verify_record (offline check of any Predge signed record against the published key set), predge_key_status and predge_desk_config. Paid: wallets ranked by outcome-verified win rate on RESOLVED markets, smart-money consensus, whale trades, and signed attestations on one ed25519 primitive: /v1/attest (settled Polymarket outcome) and /v1/sports/attest (finished game result, winner + final score), verifiable offline against Predge's published key. Pay-per-call over x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) with your OWN funded key, which stays on this machine, or set a free 30-day pilot key from predge.io/start (PREDGE_KEY): the settlement estimate and verdicts are then free inside the pilot window.

buyer_private_key.title: Buyer private key
buyer_private_key.description: A funded Base-mainnet EVM private key (0x...) used to sign USDC micropayments per paid call. Stays on your machine. Leave empty to use only the free tools (and whatever PREDGE_KEY covers).

predge_key.title: Predge key (optional)
predge_key.description: A pilot key from https://predge.io/start (settlement estimate and verdicts free for 30 days, verdict report) or a Desk key from https://predge.io/desk. Sent only as the x-predge-key header to the Predge API.

max_price_usd.title: Max price per call (USD)
max_price_usd.description: Refuse any call priced above this (USD) before money moves.

solana_buyer_secret.title: Solana buyer secret
solana_buyer_secret.description: Optional. A funded Solana-mainnet key (64-number JSON array or base58) to ALSO pay on Solana. Stays on your machine. Either this or the Base key enables paid tools.
